name: Padmaja Saran

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Padmaja Saran writes poetry and fiction in Odia. In a 2022 interview, she traced her beginnings to a family tradition of poets and pala performers, and to a poem she wrote for her school magazine in Class Seven. Her books include Deha Dehantara, Dinlipi and Kasturi Kshata. She describes writing as an ongoing search: revisiting a collection can reveal how much still remains to be expressed.

In “କାହିଁ ଏତେ ମୁଗ୍ଧ କର”, love holds contrary experiences together: affection and resentment, praise and disgrace, the full moon and a sleepless moonless night. A quiet river becomes a restless sea, while childhood, youth and the hour of return gather into a single attachment. The repeated question gives the poem its intimate, wondering rhythm.
